messages:
evan_sales: Quick heads-up — FinCorp trial kickoff tomorrow. Need to align the success matrix (latency / cost / quality) + a short runbook for the customer. Can we confirm targets, eval plan, and a provisional timeline?

alex_ryan: From SE side: proposed acceptance thresholds to start the conversation — p95 latency <= 200ms for typical chat requests (<=512 tokens), cost target < $1.00 per 1k tokens, and quality: human-eval pass >= 88% on the core prompt set. Suggest we run ~200 prompt evals + ~20 adversarial cases.

samira: SRE note — 200ms p95 might be optimistic depending on region and model size. Recommend p95 <= 250ms, p99 < 500ms as a safer SLO for the POC, and we need expected concurrency (RPS / sustained connections) from FinCorp to size the reserved pool. Also: logging and audit routes must be enabled for the trial.

maria_g: Product framing: let's split success into three buckets: Blockers (security/KMS, data residency), Must-haves (latency / cost / core quality), Nice-to-haves (observability, per-route cost breakdown). For quality we should define an automatic regression guard (if pass rate drops >4% vs baseline, fail).

jin-ml: ML ops input — Eval plan suggestion: four prompt buckets: core intents (100), edge cases (50), hallucination/sanity checks (30), safety/regulatory prompts (20). Metrics: top-1 correctness, hallucination rate, and an overall pass rate. Safety target: hallucination rate < 5%. For cost testing, we should run a model-variant comparison: baseline fp16 vs 8-bit quantized variant A to quantify quality delta vs cost savings.

ev an_sales: Pricing question from FinCorp — they'd prefer a 6-month reserved pool if unit economics are favorable. Can you run a quick burn calc so we can give a per-inference estimate for both reserved and pay-as-you-go?

alex_ryan: I'll run the burn calc and share numbers today. Quick back-of-envelope: with quantized model, batching (avg batch 8), and their expected token mix, estimate ~ $0.65 per 1k tokens. Will validate with more precise simulation.

maria_g: Also flag: they sent a security questionnaire that calls out KMS + VPC peering + SOC2 controls. We need to confirm whether we can support customer-managed keys during the POC and what logging retention we offer.

samira: We can support customer-managed KMS + private endpoints for the POC. Ops will need ~48 hours lead to provision a limited-scope Private deployment (VPC peering + IAM roles) and wire up audit logs to their SIEM. I'll add the checklist to the runbook.

ejan_sales: Timeline proposal: kickoff Mon -> 2-week infra/setup (including KMS/VPC) -> 2-week evals (automated nightly runs) -> 1-week wrap & acceptance sign-off. Are we good with that cadence?

jin-ml: 2-week eval window works if we automate scoring and run nightly batches. I'll prepare the eval harness and label schema; need a single shared CSV with expected outputs for automated scoring.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: placeholder — canary workflow available once config approved. Canary window can be scheduled as needed.

alex_ryan: Sharing initial artifacts shortly (prompt set + draft burn calc). Link (placeholder): https://redwood.example/promptsets/fin-trial — will update with real doc.

ev an_sales: Action items summary: alex_ryan = burn calc + prompt set; samira = provision KMS/VPC + runbook checklist + ETA; jin-ml = eval harness + scoring schema; maria_g = produce final success-matrix doc and acceptance criteria; I'll confirm cadence with FinCorp Wed EOD. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

mar ia_g: A couple small clarifications — 1) do we want to gate acceptance on cost threshold OR allow tradeoffs (e.g., slightly higher cost if quality > 92%)? 2) who signs final POC acceptance from their side (need contact)?

alex_ryan: RE 1) propose primary gate on quality + security, with cost as negotiable threshold (we'll include both hard and soft limits in acceptance doc). RE 2) Evan, can you confirm FinCorp signatory?

ev an_sales: Confirming FinCorp signatory = Priya Sharma (Head of ML Prod). I'll add her to the invites and share required contact info. Will loop back after I sync with her.

samira: Noted — I'll plan provisioning based on that timeline, will call out any infra blockers early.

jin-ml: I'll start building the eval harness today — will push a gist and request quick reviews.

ev an_sales: Great — meeting adjourned. I'll post the customer sync notes after my call.
